subject: GCR
_epistemic_status: PRIOR MONIKER: he states outright (img034) that he posted as 'trueshiba' in August 2020, before @GiganticRebirth. He rotates handles and later self-discloses them.

NAMING FAMILY: the token 'Rebirth' recurs across @GiganticRebirth, @rebirthdao and the FTX alias Gigantic-Cassocked-Rebirth. Searched against data/agents, data/vaults, data/referral and data/subaccounts on 2026-09-10 for rebirth|gigantic|gcr|ezekiel|ming|mecca|trueshiba|kabosu|goblin|stonehenge - ZERO hits. Re-run that search whenever new agent or vault names are collected; it is cheap and it is the free equivalent of the human-chosen-label idea in agent_links.naming_families.
THIS IS A HYPOTHESIS ABOUT THE TARGET, NOT A FACT ABOUT HIM.
The operator puts the probability that the tracked wallet is GCR's at 55-75%.
So this profile must be able to move that estimate DOWN as well as up. Any use
that can only confirm is worthless.
NEVER reason: 'the target is GCR, GCR does X, therefore a wallet doing X is the
target.' That is circular and would manufacture false leads. The profile is an
INDEPENDENT reference: a wallet may match GCR's documented style without any
link to the target, and that is exactly what makes it useful if he migrates to
a wallet we cannot connect by flow.
Provenance is public writing from Feb 2021 - Apr 2023. The target's on-chain
history begins 2026-02-05, three to five years later. Specific trades cannot be

sources.content: 149 tweets, Feb 2021 - Apr 2023, plus 16 distilled principles
sources.note: Byte-identical to the file previously committed as source_analysis.docx

sources.content: 119 pages: 245 tweet screenshots, 85 annotated charts, 76 mixed
sources.note: Almost no text layer (137 chars) - the content IS the images. Contains tweets ABSENT from the docx, e.g. fading listing pumps on IOTX/TRU/CLV/MNGO/AXS.
The corpus is not only Twitter: img251 and img282 are DISCORD posts from a private group, with content absent from the tweet archive.

principles.name: Low unit bias
principles.claim: Retail is magnetically drawn to low-unit-price coins.

principles.name: Schelling points
principles.claim: Round numbers act as support/resistance, especially absent any valuation rationale.
principles.evidence: Blotter sizes: -280,000 RLC, -47,000 GTC, -27,000 AVAX, -90,000 BAND, -233,000 BAKE, -12,000 ETC (img089/096/097). Also two deliberately off-round sizes, -999,999 ADA and -19,001 ETC. img112 names it as the trade reason outright: round schelling point number plus thick sells above was 'a bit too tempting'.; used as an EXIT rule too - img336 ('8 cents is a nice round number to take profit') and img369 ('$10 schelling point support').

principles.name: Never short small caps
principles.claim: Do not short micro/small caps; supply can be cornered after seller exhaustion.
principles.caveat: CONTRADICTED BY HIS OWN POSTS. A screenshot-only tweet describes fading listing pumps on IOTX, TRU, CLV, MNGO, AXS - all small caps. The rule appears to mean 'do not short cornered, exhausted small caps', not 'never short anything small'. Do not treat a small-cap short as a contradiction on its own. CORROBORATED BY THE BLOTTERS: he simultaneously held shorts in RLC, GRT, EGLD, BAKE, SRM, GTC and BAND.

principles.name: Momentum persistence
principles.claim: Strong stays strong; cutting winners to add to losers is backwards.
principles.caveat: IN TENSION WITH img200, where he DOUBLED a losing SHIB short from 30,872,000,000 to 61,509,800,000 and let the loss run from -$8,789 to -$637,069 on purpose ('Going to leave room to add to this if it keeps running'). The reconciliation is that he sizes small enough to add, so the scale-in is planned rather than a bagholder's average-down - which is also why his liquidation prices sit so far away. Do NOT implement adds_to_losers as a contradiction without resolving this.

principles.name: Fading DOGE pumps
principles.claim: Fading DOGE pumps was among the highest hit-rate trades post-SNL.

principles.name: Intuition over analysis
principles.claim: Edge is intuition, not chart-drawing or complex strategy.

principles.name: New vs old coins
principles.claim: New coins beat old ones: hope, no bagholders, motivated teams.

principles.name: News reaction trading
principles.claim: How the market reacts to news matters more than whether the news is true.

principles.name: Risk timing
principles.claim: Maximise risk early in an alt cycle and reduce over time.

principles.name: Long-term conviction
principles.claim: Most with long horizons should hold BTC and ETH rather than trade.

principles.name: Hedged alt book
principles.claim: Wrote about shorting weaker alts against favoured longs and being 'delta neutral' (img282, Dec 2021).
principles.caveat: CONTRADICTED BY HIS OWN BLOTTERS. img089 is 8 shorts against one ~$1k SUSHI long; img096 is 7 shorts and nothing else; img097 is 6 shorts and a single long the review's compiler circled 'long?' because it stood out. Delta-neutral is a phase he rotates into after booking profits, not his standing structure. A one-sided short book is NOT evidence against him — an earlier check_hedged_book scored it CONTRADICTS and was removed for exactly that.

principles.name: Funding arbitrage
principles.claim: Prefers funding-rate arbitrage over smart-contract yield farming.

principles.name: Alt/BTC ratio framing
principles.claim: Analyses alts denominated in BTC, not only USD.
principles.evidence: img292.jpg - six-panel SOLBTC/ADABTC/DOTBTC/AVAXBTC/FTMBTC/ALGOBTC chart marking an alt top

principles.name: Fade listing pumps
principles.claim: Shorts newly listed futures into the listing pump.
principles.evidence: img150.jpg - tweet naming IOTX, TRU, CLV, MNGO, AXS

principles.name: Long panic sells
principles.claim: Buys panic sells from DeFi exploits; the market forgets within hours.

principles.name: Bear at heart
principles.claim: Self-described bear; did his best work in the 2018-2019 bear market.
principles.caveat: DIRECTION IS REGIME, NOT IDENTITY. img007 is an FTX grouped-positions panel with BTC, ETH and SUSHI all LONG and $2.19M open. He wrote 'Remember to never short in a bull market' (img020), 'Ok, back to degen longing' (img022) and 'Exceptionally rare I'll short alts in THESE CONDITIONS' (img011). A long book is NOT evidence against him — check_net_short_bias no longer returns CONTRADICTS.

principles.name: Broad simultaneous short basket
principles.claim: Runs seven to nine alt shorts at once, cross-margined at 1x-5x, rather than one concentrated bet.
principles.evidence: img089 (9 positions), img096 (7), img097 (7); img320 is TWENTY-TWO simultaneous shorts on FTX with $17,079,515.12 of open profit (20 of 22 in the green), and img321 says there were 'plenty more on Binance' - so the real book spanned venues.

principles.name: Short supply-unlock events
principles.claim: Shorts into listing pumps and airdrop unlocks, and exits fast.
principles.evidence: img150 (IOTX/TRU/CLV/MNGO/AXS listings), img226 (dYdX airdrop: 'going to close here for pennies... don't love the rr of holding this open too long')
principles.note: Not yet implemented — would need entry timing against listing dates.

principles.name: Nearly unliquidatable
principles.claim: Runs low leverage on cross margin so positions cannot be liquidated out of him; willing to sit through large drawdowns.
principles.evidence: img013 ('Nearly impossible to liquidate me... ready to hold this open for months'); blotters at 1x-5x cross (img049/089/096/097); img012 -> img017 shows the same 8,346,280 CHZ short carried from -$470k to +$2.1M. MEASURED on his own blotters: img113 shows Est. liquidation price 'Infinity'; img007/032/059/060/123 show 'N/A'; img023 sits ~690% from liquidation and img082 ~79%. img125: 'I have unlimited collateral, you don't'. Every measurable case clears the 50% SAFE threshold, which was set from his leverage before these were read.
principles.note: THE disconfirming check. Tests how he carries risk, which survives the regime, rather than which way he points, which does not.

principles.name: Uses exchange subaccounts
principles.claim: Ran multiple FTX subaccounts and viewed them aggregated.
principles.evidence: img007 — 'Show positions on all subaccounts' and 'Group positions across accounts' both enabled.
principles.note: Off-chain and not directly testable, but it is a documented habit of splitting activity across accounts, which is the behaviour this project exists to detect on-chain.

principles.name: Trades basket instruments
principles.claim: Traded FTX's ALTPERP altcoin index, not only single names.
principles.evidence: img175 — ALTPERP 2h chart annotated 'Take profit on SHORTS'.

principles.name: Conviction is not position
principles.claim: Holds long-term conviction in coins he is simultaneously short.
principles.evidence: img219 (Telegram: 'doge is forever, an original classic like bitcoin') against DOGE -19,401,834 short in img089/img096.
principles.note: A warning against inferring belief from a position, or the reverse.

principles.name: Rotates pseudonyms
principles.claim: Has used at least four public identities and discloses old ones later.
principles.evidence: img034 - 'An old prediction I made in August 2020 about $SHIB under the moniker, trueshiba', with the original Discord post quoted.
principles.note: Off-chain, but the same instinct this project hunts on-chain: one operator, several fronts, revealed only in hindsight.

principles.name: Came from prediction markets
principles.claim: Traded political prediction markets full time for years before crypto.
principles.evidence: img186; img185 is a BetFair slip backing Valerie Pecresse at 65-70:1, GBP 49,000 staked for GBP 3,136,000 profit.
principles.note: He is not crypto-native. The tracked wallet's HIP-3 xyz: book is also not crypto - long SP500 and XYZ100 against short MU and SKHX. A real point of similarity, but comfort outside crypto is common among large traders.

principles.name: Capped-downside asymmetry
principles.claim: Structures trades so the loss is small and known while the upside is many multiples: a -1% mental stop, or a bet whose liability is the stake.
principles.evidence: img182 (-1% mental stop on announcement trades), img185 (liability = stake), img178 (cuts small losses regardless of his own bias).
principles.note: Explains 'Trigger Orders (0)' in img032/img059 - the stop is MENTAL, so it never appears as a resting order.

principles.name: Relative-value pairs
principles.claim: Expresses views as one leg against another rather than as a directional bet: long DOGE against short SHIB on marketcap convergence.
principles.evidence: img199 (the thesis), img200 (the SHIB leg), img201 ('the long DOGE, short SHIB on flippening trade satisfied profit target').; img310: 'some have been confused why i've been advocating so hard for pair trades - pretty nice feel when the coins you're longing still pump on idiosyncratic strength while the ones you're short are bleeding out'.; img388 is the fullest statement: 'the key was to focus on PAIR TRADING, and to stay DELTA NEUTRAL TO NET SHORT on the general market, while being able to pick the winners'.
principles.note: Beside the target's xyz: book - long SP500 and XYZ100 against short MU and SKHX, two memory-chip competitors - this is a genuine structural rhyme. Recorded as evidence only; pairs trading is common among large traders.

principles.name: Scales out to a dust residual
principles.claim: Says 'fully out' while a token residual remains, rather than closing flat. He calls them MOONBAGS (img218).
principles.evidence: img203 (145 1INCH, $1,044, while declaring 'fully out'), img059 (214,168 DOGE after 'sold most of my DOGE'), img113 (224.7 AXS with a break-even of 1,006 against a 44 mark).; img218 states the strategy outright: 'get in early, take some healthy profits on parabolic moves, and hold moonbags'.
principles.note: The target shows the same shape - 7 positions under $10k, the smallest TIA at $1,559, against a largest of $36.1M. NOT built as a check: any wallet with 56 positions has a wide size distribution, so it cannot discriminate, and the suite already has too few checks that can disconfirm.

principles.name: Shorts low float, high emissions
principles.claim: Selects shorts on tokenomics - low float with large scheduled unlocks and fading narratives - not on price action.
principles.evidence: img242 ('focus of my DAO has been researching/shorting the most inflationary alts with low float and mammoth 2022 emissions'), img239, img281 ('getting precision information on distributions', in a Discord channel called #the-big-short), img303, img324.
principles.note: NOT IMPLEMENTED. It would need a float and unlock-schedule source per market, which this project does not have. Recorded because it is the most specific and most testable claim in the entire corpus - far better than any style trait - if such a source is ever added.

principles.name: Risks 1-2% of net worth per position
principles.claim: Explicit sizing rule: do not risk more than 1-2% of net worth.
principles.evidence: img213. Consistent with liquidation prices 80-690% away and with img142's 'NFT exposure is 7 figures, but constitutes less than 1% of my net worth'.

principles.name: Goes quiet by choice
principles.claim: Announces deliberate breaks after big trades resolve.
principles.evidence: img322 - 'TP on majority of [liquid] shorts, and taking my first trading sabbatical in a half decade... will reassess after pilgrimage'.
principles.note: Relevant to src/dormancy.py: a silence can be a sabbatical rather than a migration, and this is a documented instance of exactly that.

principles.name: Treats visibility as a cost
principles.claim: Removed himself from a public P&L leaderboard, blurred position names before posting, and warned people not to copytrade him.
principles.evidence: img337 ('going disable my account being visible on this; visibility is -ev'), img320/img321 (positions blurred 'to save you from copytrading'), img307, img170, img176, img144.
principles.note: OPERATIONAL. Hyperliquid's leaderboard is computed from public state and has no opt-out, so he could not hide there the way he did on FTX - but a new wallet is small and outside any top-N for a long time regardless. src/scanner.py draws candidates from the leaderboard, so it finds a fresh wallet late or not at all; flow, linkage and dormancy are what find one early. Do not let the behavioural vector become the primary net.

principles.name: Most profit is off-perp
principles.claim: About 75% of net profit came from spot, other exchanges, IEOs/IDOs, DeFi, NFTs and on-chain activity rather than the perp account.
principles.evidence: img337; img144 ('most of my position was actually spot and not reflected here'); img163 (a 2,000,000 USDC NFT sale).
principles.note: Every blotter in this corpus is a partial view, and so is any read of a single Hyperliquid perp account.

principles.name: Confirmed Ethereum footprint
principles.claim: GCR controlled 0x246eA68F4516F2d09DE8754708255D567477Ec21 in 2021-22, and moved $21.6M of its proceeds to 0xd7d8f266... which stayed active until 2024-12-21.
principles.evidence: Zora token 3372's full transfer history plus the 2,000,000 USDC payment, cross-checked against four claims in img163.
principles.note: THE ONLY GCR VECTOR THAT IS FLOW RATHER THAN STYLE. It currently returns nothing - no contact with the target, no Hyperliquid presence - which is expected given the 2024/2026 gap and is NOT evidence against the hypothesis. Its value is as a tripwire.

annotations: OI + funding at unsustainable levels, spot buyers exhausted
observed_trades.reading: Called a top on unsustainable open interest and funding, then bought the ~20% flush.

annotations: down arrows marking a September top on every pair

One-sided short book across majors and small caps. 1000SHIB here vs the target's kSHIB is the same instrument family.
No longs at all. Two sizes sit one unit off a round number.
An all-long book. Direction tracks the regime.
Same size carried through a drawdown into profit — the risk posture behind 'nearly impossible to liquidate me'.
Small-cap short on FTX; liquidation price redacted.
BTC as a standing 5x cross short, round size.

review_state.note: All 406 images triaged via scripts/contact_sheets.py; everything with notes was then read at full resolution. Three review passes each overturned or corrected a check: hedged_book removed, net_short_bias stopped disconfirming, and the runner was found blind to the HIP-3 xyz: book. Remaining unreviewed entries are charts and duplicates the sheets showed carried nothing new.
review_state.how_to_find_blotters: Pixel heuristics FAIL — blotters run 1 row to 9, light (Binance) and dark (FTX); a filter tuned on three light blotters missed img335. Use scripts/contact_sheets.py and look at the grids.
review_state.highest_value_next: Remaining blotters. Positions, sizes and leverage are the only material that compares directly against on-chain data.
review_state.open_lead: RESOLVED 2026-09-10. The img163/img164 NFT sale led to a confirmed GCR Ethereum address, 0x246eA68F4516F2d09DE8754708255D567477Ec21, and a cluster around it worth $66.6M. None of it touches Hyperliquid or the target. See data/labels/gcr_addresses.json and src/gcr_wallets.py; it is now a tripwire.
review_state.compiler_redactions: Redactions come from TWO sources. GCR himself blurred market names and sizes before posting, to stop copytrading (img320, explained in img321). Whoever assembled the PDF additionally whites out liquidation prices (img012, img036, img200 x2, img335), position sizes (img007, img032) and third-party handles (img203, img219). Liquidation distance is therefore only partly measurable from this corpus, which matters because it is the one disconfirming check.
